# OWON Technology — Smart IoT Device Manufacturer

> XIAMEN OWON TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD (OWON) designs and manufactures smart IoT devices for energy management, smart buildings, hotels and senior care — smart energy meters, smart thermostats, hotel control systems and senior-care monitoring kits across ZigBee, MQTT and Tuya ecosystems.

## Blog
- [AI Behavior Trajectory Monitoring for Seniors Living Alone](https://www.owon-iot.com/blog/ai-behavior-trajectory-monitoring-seniors/) — Real deployment Case N014: a battery-powered PIR + door sensor + bed presence pad kit with ZigBee + 4G-CAT1 communication caught a 1h41m bathroom stay, a missed morning routine and fragile sleep before they became emergencies. Explains why millimeter-wave radar (multi-unit interference, cannot see through walls) cannot deliver whole-house trajectory tracking, and how the modular kit scales with sleep radar, fall-detection radar or an auto-shuttering privacy camera.
